summary.en: The Detective Boys, without Haibara and Ayumi, are walking in the street when they hear screams in a house. It turns out a lady and her daughter felled of the stairs and they treat the boys like they are robbers. The young woman's husband is trying to help the women, but they treat him as a servant. Location: Hirasawa household Victim: Seiko Hirasawa and Kaori Hirasawa Age: 68 years old (Seiko) and 27 years old (Kaori) Cause: Fall from stairs Then, the Detective Boys, this time with Ayumi, are in a park and they see the husband of the house buying food. Ayumi recognizes him and says he is Ryoji Hirasawa, the husband of the daughter of Hirasawa family, a family who owns various properties around the city. The mother Seiko Hirasawa and the daughter and Ryoji's wife Kaori Hirasawa are part of the family, when Ryoji, who previously worked in an insurance company who had business with the Hirasawas married to the daughter. Ryoji trips and falls, but the Detective Boys help him and accompany him to the house. The women keep treating Ryoji as a servant and order him to cook for them, while they go jogging, but a minutes later the boys hear a scream, and find that the women were hit by a car. Location: Intersection near Hirasawa household Victim: Seiko Hirasawa and Kaori Hirasawa Age: 68 years old (Seiko) and 27 years old (Kaori) Modus operandi: Hit by car Suspects: Kinue Hasegawa The women are delivered to the hospital in an ambulance. Meanwhile, Conan managed to follow the car that ran over the women, and the driver is a young lady. Conan follows the woman who arrives to Beika Hospital and talks to Ryoji, who is also there. It seems the lady is an employee of the same insurance company employee mentioned before.
